summary: Sets up a temporary "Special Event Zone" in parts of downtown Nashville for the 2026 July 4th Celebration, from 9:00 p.m. on July 2, 2026 to 11:59 p.m. on July 5, 2026. Within the zone, unapproved vending, alcohol sales, tents, free-product giveaways, firearms, knives, fireworks and drones are barred, and shared urban mobility devices are not allowed, while public participation areas are set aside for people to express themselves.
